summary: FRONTEND-only test of Budgy 4.0 stabilisation on the Expo web preview at 390x844, demo mode, English. PASSING: (1) PLUS screen: 5 sections in order FINANCES / DOCUMENTS / INTELLIGENCE / SWISS SERVICES / ACCOUNT (FR/DE/IT keys present too) and the 17 plus-row-<id> testIDs in the expected order. BETA badge on Budgy Twin. The 'Discover Budgy Pro' card goes to /pro and the 'DU' avatar goes to /more/settings. Budgy Alerts is fully visible above the floating bar at the bottom of the scroll. (2) NAVIGATION: all 17 rows open a non-blank screen with 0 page errors. calendar, export-pdf, budgy-score, tax and subscription go to /pro in FREE demo. Back returns to /more every time (browser back and the in-app back-button). (3) P0 BUDGETS: + opens 'New budget'. 'Choose a category' opens the grouped picker (31 options, search) inside the same Modal. Close by X and close by tapping the backdrop both keep amount and name. 3 opens in a row work. Search 'groc' returns only Groceries and a nonsense query returns 0 results. Picking Groceries shows the label in the form and keeps the fields. Amount 600 then create shows the budget (CHF 0 / CHF 600). It persists after reload. Groceries is then excluded from the next picker. Creating custom category TEST_Velo selects it and creates its budget. Cancelling the form saves nothing and the form is reset on reopen. Validation works for no category and for 'abc'. (4) P0 FIXED CHARGES: the add form category select opens the picker in the same modal. X keeps the fields. Search 'subscr' returns Subscriptions and selecting it works. TEST_Netflix 17.90 monthly is created and listed. Edit via '...' then Edit, rename to 'TEST_Netflix HD' and Save works. The add form and picker reopen fine afterwards: no screen stays blocked. (5) NON-REGRESSION: Home 'Available this month' banner and the 'How this is calculated' breakdown modal, the Expenses tab and the Savings tab render with 0 pageerrors and 0 console errors (other than the known RN-web warnings). ISSUES: one MEDIUM bug: a custom category created from the Recurring picker shows its raw id 'custom_1794522245003' in the form and gets a grey color. Also: 17.90 is displayed as 'CHF 18' (rounding), plus several i18n leaks and Android back-button picker state (details below). I added testIDs only (no logic changes).

ui_bugs.issue: When you create a custom category from the CategoryGroupPicker in /more/recurring, the select shows the raw id 'custom_1794522245003' and a grey color. Cause: getCategoryName(newRec.category) and getCategoryColor() only look in EXPENSE_CATEGORIES/CATEGORY_COLORS and never in store customCategories (budgets.tsx does handle this via catLabelOf/catColorOf). The saved charge also gets color = textSecondary. Reference: app/more/recurring.tsx:255, :497-500, src/components/CategoryIcon.tsx:101-119

A 17.90 charge shows as 'CHF 18' in the list, the hero (CHF 18, ≈CHF 215/yr), Due this month, the action sheet and Home 'Committed CHF 18 / Available -18'. Cause: formatNumber() defaults to 0 decimals. This is misleading for a finance app. Reference: src/utils/calculations.ts:9, app/more/recurring.tsx:295,322,370

ui_bugs.component: Recurring add form category label not localized
ui_bugs.issue: The selected category shows French names ('Abonnements', 'Télécoms') in the EN UI while the picker shows 'Subscriptions' / 'Telecoms'. Cause: getCategoryName(newRec.category) is called without t. Reference: app/more/recurring.tsx:500

With no category chosen, 'Choose a category first.' is rendered under the MONTHLY LIMIT field and the amount input gets a red border, so the error points at the wrong field. Reference: app/more/budgets.tsx:164,371,380

The search query (and the 'creating' mode) persists between openings: after searching 'groc' and selecting, reopening the picker still shows 'groc' with only 1 result. Reset query/creating in onClose/onSelect. Reference: src/components/CategoryGroupPicker.tsx:40-42

ui_bugs.component: Recurring add form not reset on cancel
ui_bugs.issue: Closing the form with X keeps the last chosen category (e.g. Télécoms) on reopen while the title is empty. The behaviour is inconsistent; budgets resets fully. Reference: app/more/recurring.tsx:451

integration_issues.flow: Android hardware back while picker open (code review, not testable on web)
integration_issues.issue: Modal onRequestClose only sets showAdd/showAddModal=false. It does not close the picker first and never resets showCatPicker. On Android, back with the picker open closes the whole form and the next form open shows the picker immediately. Handle back as: if showCatPicker, close the picker; otherwise close the form. Reference: app/more/budgets.tsx:342, app/more/recurring.tsx:441

issues: The extruded section titles render the same Text 4 times (depth layers). Screen readers will read 'FINANCES' 4 times. Add accessibilityElementsHidden / importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' (aria-hidden) on depth1-3. Reference: app/(tabs)/more.tsx:71-73

Category edit still uses the legacy horizontal chip row that overflows the screen, with untranslated French EXPENSE_CATEGORIES names on the EN UI and near-duplicate entries ('Assurances compl. (LCA)' and 'Assurance complémentaire LCA', 'RC & ménage' and 'Assurances RC / ménage'). The selected chip is off-screen and custom categories cannot be chosen. Consider reusing CategoryGroupPicker. Reference: app/more/recurring.tsx:171, app/more/budgets.tsx:141
Savings idea chips in French ('Achat immobilier', 'Voiture neuve'…)
Recurring action sheet subtitle hardcodes '/mois' and 'Jour' (recurring.tsx:350,425)
Home empty-state text in French ('Ajoutez votre premier revenu…')

action_items: MEDIUM: recurring.tsx: resolve label/color/icon of custom categories from useStore customCategories (as budgets.tsx catLabelOf/catColorOf do), both in the form select and in getCategoryColor at save time
MEDIUM: show 2 decimals for CHF amounts in Recurring (formatNumber(x, 2), or hide decimals only when they are .00); check that Home Committed/Available use the same formatting
LOW: pass t to getCategoryName in recurring.tsx:500
LOW: modal onRequestClose in budgets.tsx:342 / recurring.tsx:441: close the picker first if it is open, and reset showCatPicker when the form closes
LOW: CategoryGroupPicker: reset query/creating/newName on close/select
LOW: budgets form: show the no-category error under the category select instead of under the amount field
LOW: aria-hide the 3 extruded depth Text layers in more.tsx SectionTitle
LOW: fix the i18n leaks listed in design_issues
critical_code_review_comments: The P0 architecture is correct: CategoryGroupPicker returns an absolute overlay (zIndex 1000) rendered as a sibling of the KAV inside the parent Modal, so there is no second native Modal. Verified on web; final iOS validation still needs a native build.
more.tsx: the useMemo wraps the whole JSX and deliberately omits router/open from deps. This works because `open` closes over isPro, which is in deps, but it is fragile if more state is added later.
budgets.tsx and recurring.tsx are 527/656 lines; recurring.tsx is close to the 700-line limit.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/CategoryGroupPicker.tsx (testIDs only: category-picker, category-picker-close, category-picker-search, category-option-<id>, category-picker-create, category-picker-new-name, category-picker-create-confirm)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all P0/P1 requested flows pass; 1 medium bug in the custom-category branch of Recurring, 1 medium display rounding issue)

seed_data_creation: None in any DB. Demo mode keeps data in browser localStorage only (fresh context per run): TEST_Courses / Groceries 600, TEST_Velo 120, TEST_Netflix(HD) 17.90, TEST_Gym 49.50, custom categories TEST_Velo / TEST_Fitness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run is a fresh context: click 'Continue' (language), then 'Explore in demo mode', then page.goto('/more/budgets' or '/more/recurring'). testIDs: add-budget, budget-category-select, budget-amount-input, budget-create-btn, budget-form-close, add-recurring, recurring-title-input, recurring-amount-input, recurring-category-select, category-picker, category-picker-search, category-picker-close, category-option-<categoryId> (e.g. courses, restaurant, abonnements, telecoms), category-picker-create, category-picker-new-name, category-picker-create-confirm. The Recurring submit Button has no testID (the ui Button doesn't accept one): use get_by_text('Add', exact=True).last. Recurring form X is at (357,335). Row '...' menu is about 14px above the title row at x=356. The Home breakdown opens by tapping 'After expenses and charges to pay'.
rca_of_issue: Custom category shows a raw id in Recurring: CategoryGroupPicker.createCustom() adds {id:'custom_<ts>'} to store.customCategories and calls onSelect(id). recurring.tsx renders the label with getCategoryName(id), which only searches EXPENSE_CATEGORIES/INCOME_CATEGORIES and falls back to returning the id. getCategoryColor likewise falls back to grey. Budgets is unaffected because it uses catLabelOf/catColorOf, which look in customCategories.
